mindtraced_atomic_units: Counter has a period of 1000 cycles
Counter increments on each clock cycle
spec_atomic_units: Module top_module has output reg [9:0] q
Output 'q' represents the current count value
q updates only on the rising edge of clk
When reset is high at the rising edge of clk, q is synchronously reset to 0
When reset is low at the rising edge of clk, q increments, unless it is already at 999, in which case it resets to 0
The critical path involves the reset signal and the current value of `q`
The counter's behavior is defined within an `always @(posedge clk)` block
The `q` signal is declared as a `reg [9:0]`
The counter uses non-blocking assignments (`<=`) to update the value of `q` on each clock cycle
If the counter reaches 999, it resets to 0 on the next clock cycle
